title: Garlic Chili Oil Cheddar & Scallion Focaccia
creator: cybelewells
steps: Mix the dough ingredients in a stand mixer and knead about 6 minutes until smooth and elastic. It will be wet and sticky.

Drizzle about 4 tbsp chilli oil on a half sheet pan, add the dough and flip it so both sides are oiled. Spread it out, scatter half the cheddar and two-thirds of the spring onions, letter-fold it and flip seam-side down.
Cover and let it rise until doubled and very puffy. Heat the oven to 190 °C.
Brush with the remaining chilli oil, sprinkle with flaky salt, sesame and the rest of the spring onions, dimple with oiled fingers and top with the remaining cheddar.
Bake 30–35 minutes until deep golden and the cheese is crisp at the edges. Cool slightly before slicing.
